analysis.purpose: The deterministic query surface behind every MCP tool: pure functions over the soul and its derived index that answer what a symbol is, what it touches, what breaks if it changes, and what has been learned about it.
responsibilities: Implement every read verb — brief, context, query, impact, dossier, neighbors
Attach authored meaning to hits, inheriting from the owning file or cluster
Report grounding and coverage so a caller knows prose from raw source
Hold every response inside an explicit token budget
Serve trusted memory alongside code results without fusing their scores

businessRules.rule: Code results and memory results are returned as separate typed groups and their scores are never fused.
businessRules.rationale: They are different kinds of evidence and ranking them together would hide which is which.

businessRules.rule: Every response is bounded by a token budget and reports truncation rather than silently dropping content.
businessRules.rationale: A silently trimmed answer reads as complete when it is not.

businessRules.rule: Inherited prose is always tagged with the layer it came from, so a file purpose is never mistaken for a symbol purpose.
businessRules.rationale: Prevents a plausible-but-wrong attribution of meaning.

nodes.name: Deterministic query surface
nodes.summary: Bounded, provenance-tagged answers over the graph.

edges.rationale: This file implements the verbs every MCP tool calls.
